offers.requirements:
About you 

You take pride in the quality of your work and care deeply about the candidate experience. You are structured enough to follow the process but also know when to be flexible. Speed matters to you but not at the expense of quality. 

You work well in a team, and bring energy and enthusiasm to your work. You share what you learn, ask for feedback and show curiosity about the industry and how tools and AI can raise the bar. 

You know that hiring is not just about matching a CV, but also about having a strong understanding of the business, team dynamics and finding the best fit. 

What You’ll Bring 

  • 3-5 years recruiting experience (preferably in-house), ideally in a fast-moving, dynamic environment. 

  • Proven track record in hiring across commercial and operations functions. 

  • Experience in hiring across multiple countries or markets. 

  • Strong stakeholder advisory skills; you can challenge hiring managers while keeping a good relationship.
offers.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
offers.description:
About the role 

We are looking for a true hiring partner for our operations and commercial teams. Culture is critical for our success and you will help shape it. Do you enjoy building strong partnerships by advising and guiding hiring managers and candidates across multiple markets? If so, this is a role for you! 

In this role, you’ll manage the full hiring cycle for your own designated departments, where you have a lot of ownership to evolve their hiring engine. You will hire across our main office in Utrecht as well as our offices in the US, Denmark & Berlin. That means you will navigate between different business needs, hiring cultures and candidate expectations, while providing a great experience for everyone involved. 

Our People Team consists of 3 sub-departments; Talent Acquisition, Employee Experience and HR. Over the years we built a strong foundation, so you will not start from scratch. This role is for someone who can easily step into existing processes but also proactively challenges what can be improved. 

If you love hiring and want to grow in a team where your voice matters, we’d love to hear from you.

Channable is a powerful, flexible tool with a wide range of features. Mastering the tool and understanding how our customers use it is key to delivering high-quality support.

You’ll be communicating with both technical and non-technical users, so your ability to adapt your communication style is essential. You'll also need to balance speed, clarity, and customer satisfaction while maintaining ownership from start to finish.

offers.title: Technical Customer Support - French Speaking
offers.description:
Do you speak French fluently and are you passionate about solving complex problems for a diverse range of customers? Do you want to help ecommerce businesses grow by delivering high-quality technical support? Then this role might be for you!

You’ll be joining our international Support department, which consists of 5 teams supporting 9+ markets worldwide. Within this global setup, you’ll work in our Southern Europe & International inbox, supporting customers across multiple markets including France, Iberia, Italy, the UK, and beyond. Your French language skills are essential to ensure strong support coverage for our French-speaking customers, while your role will extend across the broader international scope.


We’re an open-minded and collaborative team of Support professionals. We believe Support isn’t just about fixing problems, it’s about setting our customers up for success, and we do this together. We learn from each other, keep things honest and direct, and enjoy the occasional fun moment along the way. Expect flat hierarchies, room for your ideas, and a team that’s got your back!
